items.source: The classes names that must be present.

A Class value can be safely specified on @Configuration classes as the annotation metadata is parsed by using ASM before the class is loaded. If a class reference cannot be used then a name String attribute can be used.
items.translation: `Class` 类型的 value 可以安全地指定在 @Configuration` 类上，因为注解元数据是使用 ASM 解析的，而这是在类加载之前进行的。如果无法使用类引用，则可以使用 name `String` 属性。

items.source: Note: Extra care must be taken when using @ConditionalOnClass on @Bean methods where typically the return type is the target of the condition. Before the condition on the method applies, the JVM will have loaded the class and potentially processed method references which will fail if the class is not present. items.source: The classes that must be present. Since this annotation is parsed by loading class bytecode, it is safe to specify classes here that may ultimately not be on the classpath, only if this annotation is directly on the affected component and not if this annotation is used as a composed, meta-annotation. In order to use this annotation as a meta-annotation, only use the name() attribute.
items.translation: 必须存在的类。由于此注解是通过加载类字节码进行解析的，因此如果此注解直接位于受影响的组件上（且不是作为组合元注解使用），则可以在此处指定最终可能不在类路径中的类。若要使用此注解作为元注解，仅可使用 name() 属性。
